Container.Name: print-handy
Container.Overview: Share a model link or file in Discord, Telegram or Matrix. Choose filament, review the estimate and approve the exact job before it reaches your printer. Runs locally with no Print Handy cloud; chat providers carry what you send, and model downloads or optional hosted AI use the network. Camera monitoring and AI features are optional. A camera alert is not proof that a print is safe unattended. See the printer support guide for supported connection paths and hardware verification limits. Not affiliated with Bambu Lab. Full setup and upgrade instructions are in the Print Handy docs. SETUP: all data lives in the one Appdata folder, and that folder must be writable by UID 1000 (the container user). Before the first start, run in the Unraid terminal: chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/print-handy. To use a chat bot, put its token in state/.env inside that folder (for example DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN=... or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=...) before the first start. Then open the Web UI on port 8088 to finish setup. The Web UI is open to anyone on your network until you set a password there.
Container.Requires: Appdata path owned by UID/GID 1000. Existing Spoolman data can be copied into spoolman/ under the Appdata path before first start; nothing is migrated automatically.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Print Handy Web UI. If port 8088 is already in use by another service or Docker container on your server, change this host port.

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Single persistent storage path for all Print Handy data. Runtime state, sliced jobs, records, cache, config, account tokens (.config) and the bundled Spoolman database are stored under this folder. The folder must be owned by UID/GID 1000: chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/print-handy.

Config.Name: Timelapse Archive
Config.Description: Finished timelapses are copied here. The default folder is inside Appdata; point this at another share (for example a media share) to keep timelapses somewhere else.

Config.Name: Spoolman URL
Config.Description: Bundled Spoolman API by default. To use an existing external Spoolman, set its URL here; nothing is migrated. The bundled one keeps running unless you also add a variable named PRINT_HANDY_BUNDLED_SPOOLMAN with the value false.

Config.Name: Container Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone for the container's local time (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, America/Chicago). Sets the container's local time: log timestamps and scheduled jobs. Chat display times follow the discord.timezone setting, not this one.

Config.Name: Hardware Acceleration (Intel / AMD)
Config.Description: OPTIONAL: Direct Rendering Infrastructure (/dev/dri) device pass-through for hardware-accelerated timelapse encoding on Intel (QuickSync / VA-API) or AMD (VA-API). Requires GPU drivers installed on Unraid. The entry ships empty so hosts without an iGPU still start; to enable it, set the value to /dev/dri. The container runs as UID 1000, so it also needs access to the render group: add --group-add=GID to Extra Parameters (see docs/DOCKER.md, GPU passthrough).

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: OPTIONAL (NVIDIA GPUs only): GPU UUID (e.g. GPU-xxxxxxxx) or 'all' for NVENC timelapse encoding. Requires the Unraid Nvidia-Driver plugin and '--runtime=nvidia' added to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: OPTIONAL (NVIDIA GPUs only): Driver libraries the NVIDIA runtime mounts. Default is compute,video,utility (or all).
